endpoint.selection: Exact explicit Config.EndpointOverrides (cloud_1c,v2,scope), selected after discovery; no guessed regional host; base includes /v2

request.scope: exact caller-selected regional project; global metadata does not change scope

response.mapping: All typed Region fields regionName/regionCode/regionPool, cross-region metadata permitted; never resource refs or implicit region selection

errors.mapping: Core bounded read status mapping; provider message excluded; malformed JSON ProtocolError

pagination.provider: Finite source regions array; no provider page parameter or cursor documented
pagination.local: FixedIterator enforces PageSize/MaxItems/MaxPages/CollectionTimeout and MaxJSONBytes; partial local page retains SDK replay cursor+skip
pagination.consistency: Best effort reread; no snapshot guarantee
